name: Candy Jar Clusters

features.name: Six-symbol clusters
features.description: Clusters of six or more adjacent candies pay.

features.name: Random multiplier
features.description: A multiplier up to 100x can be added to all wins in a spin.

features.name: Feature jars
features.description: Collected candies can trigger free spins, retriggers or one of five jackpots.

review:
A cluster game that needs six or more matching sweets – one more than most. Cakes, jellies and doughnuts are the top symbols, and wins cascade away.

A random multiplier up to 100x can apply to all wins on any spin, and candies in winning clusters fill feature jars – a full jar can trigger free spins with wild multipliers, retriggers, or one of five jackpots. The jars give you a visible goal. Up to 10,000x, 96.08% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
